segments.ja356:1.1: Eko araññe girikandarāyaṃ, paggayha paggayha silaṃ pavecchasi [pavejjhasi (syā. sī. aṭṭha.)];
segments.ja356:1.3: Punappunaṃ santaramānarūpo, koraṇḍiya [kāraṇḍiya (sī. syā. pī.)] ko nu tava yidhattho.
segments.ja356:2.1: Ahañhimaṃ sāgara sevitantaṃ, samaṃ karissāmi yathāpi pāṇi;
segments.ja356:2.3: Vikiriya sānūni ca pabbatāni ca, tasmā silaṃ dariyā pakkhipāmi.
segments.ja356:3.1: Nayimaṃ mahiṃ arahati pāṇikappaṃ, samaṃ manusso karaṇāya meko;
segments.ja356:3.3: Maññāmimaññeva dariṃ jigīsaṃ [jigiṃsaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)], koraṇḍiya hāhasi [hāyasi (syā. ka.)] jīvalokaṃ.
segments.ja356:4.1: Sace ahaṃ [ayaṃ (sī. syā. pī.)] bhūtadharaṃ na sakkā [sakko (syā. ka.)], samaṃ manusso karaṇāya meko;
segments.ja356:4.3: Evameva tvaṃ brahme ime manusse, nānādiṭṭhike nānayissasi te [ne (ka.)].
segments.ja356:5.1: Saṅkhittarūpena bhavaṃ mamatthaṃ, akkhāsi koraṇḍiya evametaṃ;
segments.ja356:5.3: Yathā na sakkā pathavī samāyaṃ, kattuṃ manussena tathā manussāti.
